sourceId.description:
Id of {@link DataValidationRule rule}/{@link DataValidationRuleset ruleset} to use as source of output.
If this sourceId is not found with a ruleset status/validation status category in the validation results,
this step will not be shown.

title.description: Title to show on this step.

subtitle.description: Subtitle to show on this step.

subStepSettings.description: List of {@link DataValidationUiStepSettings substeps} of this step. Substeps cannot have substeps.

bannerMessageMap.description:
JSON works as map<string, string | UiSdlDynamicValueSpec>.
Keyed by {@link DataValidationResult ruleResult}.output or {@link DataValidationRuleset ruleset} status category.
Value is the message string or dynamic value to be shown.

customComponentsMap.description: Keyed by {@link DataValidationResult ruleResult}.output or {@link DataValidationRuleset ruleset} status category. Value is an array of the ids of the custom components to show.

title: It represents the configuration of each step that compounds a UI page.
name: DataValidationUiStepSettings
